channel.title: AI Frontier Post
channel.description: Dispatches from the AI frontier: AI news, research explainers, frontier lab coverage, and product comparisons.

item.title: Same Gatekeepers, New Gateway: Open Markets warns Google, Amazon, Microsoft and Meta could control AI agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: The Open Markets Institute published a 71-page report on November 9, 2026 warning that Google, Amazon, Microsoft and Meta are positioned to control the AI agents that will shop, book and decide on our behalf — naming three forces that could lock the market shut, and five things regulators should do before it happens.

item.title: Cisco AI Defense adds Claude Mythos red teaming to stress-test enterprise AI agents
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Cisco announced on November 9, 2026 that Anthropic's Claude Mythos is joining AI Defense to attack enterprise AI agents before real attackers do — with Splunk cost tracking and Cisco IQ remediation closing the loop.

item.title: A 3-line prompt and 8.5 billion tokens: Claude Fable 5.2 built a playable Gears of War clone
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: YouTuber Matthew Berman gave Claude Fable 5.2 a three-line prompt and a few days. It built a playable Gears of War clone in Unreal Engine — cover mechanics, enemy AI, and timed reloads included. The real numbers are less viral than the headline, and more interesting.

item.title: Google Maps in AI Studio: build a location app from one prompt, free for 100 calls a day
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google put Maps Platform inside AI Studio on November 9: describe a location app to Gemini and it sets up the maps, keys and live preview itself — free for 100 calls per API a day. Shipping it still needs a paid Cloud billing account.

item.title: Claude's invisible text watermark now covers three older models as the EU's December deadline nears
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Anthropic extended its invisible text watermark to Claude Mythos 5, Opus 4.7 and Sonnet 4.6 on November 3, closing a gap before the EU AI Act's December 2 deadline — with one catch: on Sonnet 4.6, changing the sampling settings can silently drop the mark.

item.title: ChatGPT Enterprise is now on AWS Marketplace — buy it through your AWS bill
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: OpenAI put ChatGPT Enterprise on AWS Marketplace: the Chat, ChatGPT Work, Codex and dots bundle, billed through your AWS account, with existing EDP and private-pricing commitments counting toward it.

item.title: Claude Fable 5.2 launches 30% faster and cheaper; Mythos 5.2 stays vetted-only
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Anthropic's Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2 generate outputs up to 30% faster than the 5.1 generation and cost $8 per million input tokens — but Mythos stays limited to vetted security and science organizations.

item.title: Disney and Adobe build custom Firefly Foundry AI models trained on Disney characters and worlds
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Adobe becomes Disney's Official AI Innovation Partner in a multi-year alliance announced at Adobe MAX on November 9, 2026. Custom Firefly Foundry models trained on Disney's characters, environments and visual styles will speed up theme-park, studio and ESPN work — and Imagineering is already using them.

item.title: Boston Dynamics put wheels on Atlas — and the humanoid can drift, slide and jump 360
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Boston Dynamics swapped Atlas's feet for scooter wheels to stress-test its whole-body reinforcement-learning controller. The result is a 2:50 video of the humanoid drifting, sliding and landing a 360 jump — and a lesson in closing the sim-to-real gap.

item.title: Poki: let an AI agent drive your real iPhone — a hands-on setup guide
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Poki is a local MCP server that lets an AI agent see your iPhone's screen and tap, type, and scroll on it — no jailbreak. This guide installs it, pairs a real iPhone, and runs your first phone task.

item.title: Medium launches TK: an AI writing app that lives inside your drafts
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Medium opened TK to all account holders on November 9, 2026: a private notebook and writing app with an @TK assistant in the editor, AI feedback, and provenance notes that show how AI helped — free with a Medium account.

item.title: Meta Muse Ember: a $0.10-per-million-token model built for the agent grunt work
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta's Superintelligence Lab has released Muse Ember, its smallest and cheapest model yet — $0.10 per million input tokens, built for the tool calls, coding subtasks and document parsing that agents repeat all day.

item.title: Give ChatGPT your own tools: connect a custom MCP server
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: ChatGPT can now call tools you build yourself — no Developer Mode toggle, no waiting list. This guide builds a real MCP server with FastMCP, proves it works, puts it on the public internet, and connects it to ChatGPT, every step verified.

item.title: Anthropic is buying its own power plant: $3.4B of gas generators to run Claude's data centers
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Anthropic has reportedly agreed to pay about $3.4 billion for 1.7 gigawatts of gas-fired generators, taking over orders placed by Texas developer OnePWR — the largest power-equipment purchase by an AI lab yet, and a sign the compute race has become an energy race.

item.title: AI-assisted SkyBuild mod brings real-time terrain editing and live NPC navigation to Skyrim
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: SkyBuild, a Skyrim Special Edition mod by creator sokco816, adds real-time terrain sculpting, snap-together construction, and live navmesh updates so NPCs can navigate player-built homes. The creator disclosed that AI assistance helped with the low-level engine work — reverse-engineering, memory addresses, debugging — while the tool used remains undisclosed.

item.title: RLWRLD DexBench: a 15-task benchmark that grades humanoid robots on real factory handiwork
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: RLWRLD unveiled DexBench at NVIDIA AI Day Seoul on November 9, 2026: 15 dexterous-manipulation tasks across four industrial settings, built on NVIDIA Isaac Lab-Arena — and confirmed a planned investment from NVIDIA.

item.title: Altegio opens salons to AI assistants: MCP servers and API v3 put bookings, clients, and revenue inside ChatGPT
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Altegio announced an open platform at Web Summit 2026 that connects its 14,000 beauty and wellness businesses to AI assistants through MCP servers and a new API v3 — owners can ask ChatGPT about bookings, clients, and revenue instead of digging through dashboards.

item.title: Red Hat OpenShift 5 goes live: an agentic Lightspeed, a built-in MCP server, and upgrades without reinstalls
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Red Hat announced the general availability of OpenShift 5 at KubeCon on November 9, 2026 — Lightspeed is now an AI agent, a built-in MCP server opens the platform to any agent harness, and OpenShift 4 clusters upgrade in place. Available now to existing subscribers.

item.title: Google TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max: two new eighth-gen systems for confidential inference and massive context
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Google added TPU 8tx and TPU 8i Max to its eighth-generation lineup on November 9, 2026 — one for confidential inference on sensitive data, the other a dual-chip package for massive context windows. Neither is a new chip, and neither ships yet.

item.title: Ambiq heliaAOT 1.0: an edge AI compiler that cuts inference latency up to 76% on Apollo chips
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Ambiq launched heliaAOT 1.0, an ahead-of-time AI compiler that turns trained models into optimized C code for its Apollo chips — up to 76% lower inference latency and 72% lower energy per inference than LiteRT Micro on the Apollo510. Available now.

item.title: Instagram's AI age estimation goes global: Meta moves teens into Teen Accounts even with an adult birthday
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Meta is expanding its AI age-estimation system to every country on Instagram, placing millions more teens into Teen Account protections even if they signed up with an adult birthday. Here's how the checks work — and where they fall short.

item.title: Claude Code vs Codex vs Gemini CLI: which terminal coding agent to run in November 2026
item.dc:creator: Sofia Almeida
item.description: Claude Code, Codex CLI, and Gemini CLI each install with one command — but only two still take individual users. Prices, models, sandboxing, and the free tier that vanished in June.

item.title: Kolmena launches AI agent swarms: MAYA coordinates your personal AI workforce
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Kolmena launched its agentic AI platform today: specialized agents that share context and work as coordinated “swarms,” routed across models by KSPR, with 1,600+ integrations and a MAYA companion for individuals.

item.title: Israel launches NIIA, a national AI institute that measures success in real-world outcomes
item.dc:creator: Marcus Doyle
item.description: Israel's National AI Directorate formally launched the National Institute for Impact-Driven AI (NIIA) on November 9: a cross-ministry body that will run 10 to 14 missions a year against nine national challenges — and judge itself on outcomes in people's lives, not on how many projects it starts.

item.title: gputaskman hands-on: find out what is really eating your GPU memory
item.dc:creator: Priya Nair
item.description: Task Manager says 15 GB used. gputaskman — Scott Hanselman's free, open-source GPU task manager — answers the next question: per-process VRAM, model weights vs KV cache, spill and paged memory, on Windows, Linux, WSL, and macOS.
